APACHE II doubles the creatinine points for acute renal failure. Excluded if the stay has end-stage renal disease (N18.6), dialysis dependence (Z99.2) or missed dialysis (Z91.15): those patients aren't acute renal failure. Codes can only give 'yes' or 'no': no AKI code doesn't prove there was none, so 'unknown' has to come from your own data (e.g. no creatinine values). The dialysis procedure codes are optional; they catch stays where AKI needing dialysis wasn't coded. Coded AKI is also a looser definition than the creatinine-based one; consider checking KDIGO criteria against labs.
